title: Accounts Q&A — The Guarantee Standing behind a Shortfall Payment, Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# The Guarantee Standing behind a Shortfall Payment

Questions answered by the accounts office on the guarantee a shortfall payment on a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions is held to.

## Rule

Where the guarantee credited for the year stands on the record and a shortfall has been paid against it in the twelve months ending on the day of the payment, the guarantee standing is the guarantee credited in those twelve months less the shortfalls paid in them. Where the guarantee credited for the year stands on the record and no shortfall has been paid against it in those months, the guarantee standing is the guarantee credited in them. In every other case the guarantee standing is the guaranteed savings standing on the subscription.

## Questions

**What is the guarantee credited for the year?** The guaranteed savings credited to the subscription in the twelve months ending on the day of the payment, totalled by the day each credit was issued. It stands on the record where that total is above nothing.

**One or more shortfalls paid in those twelve months, with a guarantee credited.** The guarantee standing is that credited total less the shortfall payments made in the same twelve months.

**A guarantee credited in those months with no shortfall paid in them.** The guarantee standing is the credited total itself.

**No guarantee credited on the record in those months.** The guarantee standing is the guaranteed savings figure standing on the subscription.

## Summary

| Guarantee credited in the 12 months | Shortfall paid in those 12 months | Guarantee standing |
|---|---|---|
| above nothing | one or more | the credited total less the payments made in those months |
| above nothing | none | the credited total |
| nothing on record | any | the guaranteed savings standing on the subscription |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A subscription credited USD 45 000.00 of guaranteed savings in the twelve months, against which USD 8 000.00 has already been paid, carries a guarantee standing of USD 37 000.00.
